title: FOL holiday-food demonstration in Córdoba directed to private businesses
reason: The opened local report identifies the direct demand as holiday food from the private sector; it does not establish a demand on Córdoba or national government.
notes: The march route passed through city streets toward the municipal Palace 6 de Julio, but the reviewed account attributes the food demand to private businesses. Participant count is unknown and is not inferred. Revisit only if evidence identifies a separate state-policy demand.
